(e) SUPERSCRIPT CENTS throughout: line 2 Column A reads '88' with a raised '26' over a rule, line 3 the same, and both Column B cells read '52,783' with a raised '99'. All are transcribed with a decimal point per the convention. (f) COLUMN B IS IDENTICAL ON BOTH SIDES - 52,783.99 for contributions-to-date AND expenditures-to-date. contributions.detail: A REAL ZERO, not a gap. The Schedule A page (p3) EXISTS and is entirely blank - the only mark on the whole grid is a single pen dash drawn in the Name-of-Contributor cell of row 1, which is a nil mark and not a transaction, so zero rows are emitted. No anchor exists to reconcile against: Summary line 1 Column A carries only a long leader stroke ending in an arrowhead (a pen mark, not a numeral - BLANK per the zero-glyph ruling, which admits only a slashed zero, '-0-' or the word zero), line 4 carries a bare dash, and the Schedule A page's SUBTOTAL and TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED cells are both printed and left empty. Hence result=unknown, never a fabricated 0.00 stated figure.

expenditures.detail: The single Schedule B row sums to 88.26 and equals Summary line 2 Column A (88 with superscript cents 26) and Summary line 3 (88.26, the beginning balance). The schedule's own SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE and TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE cells are printed and LEFT BLANK, so there is no schedule grand total to report - the Summary figure is the only anchor and it closes exactly.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO page-subtotal gate is available on either side: p3 and p4 both print SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE and the schedule grand-total line, and the filer left ALL FOUR cells empty. The expenditures side therefore gates on Summary line 2 Column A (88.26 = the one row's 88.26); the contributions side has no printed figure at all and is an inspected blank page.
